caseName: United Brotherhood of Carpenters & Joiners of America v. Anderson
caseNameFull: United Brotherhood of Carpenters and Joiners of America v. Anderson

opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. Certiorari granted limited to the following question: “Taking into account the constitutional powers pursuant to which it was enacted, does 42 U. S. C. § 1981 prohibit discrimination against noncitizens on the basis of alienage in private contracts?”
